researchQuestion: How reliably does the existing evaluator detect source-grounded faults, and what can validated automated evidence establish about Distilled.news versus simpler baselines?
pipeline: Unmodified groundedInventoryRequest -> judge -> inventory -> groundingRequest -> judge -> parseGrounding -> groundedInventory -> groundedReviewRequest -> judge -> completeReview(groundedReview) -> groundedMetrics/flagged/operational
labels: Source-evidence-derived, frozen before inference, with explicit evidence quotes, transformation provenance and legitimate paraphrase/update controls. AI-curated references are not human gold. No tested judge supplies expected labels.
blinding: Opaque randomized case and source identifiers; fault names, expected labels, system identities and transformation metadata are never supplied to judges. The independent source inventory cannot see any candidate output.
synthetic: Balanced multilingual source-grounded controlled statements and faults. Translations and variants remain in the same event group. Keep synthetic cases separate from retained real-source mutations and real published outputs.
historical: Previously used source material is development/exploratory only. Qualify retained cases using integrity, timestamps, evidence completeness and provenance before judging; keep rejection reasons. Never silently substitute snippets for a full retained window.
pairedComparison: Reuse existing evaluate.py baseline and replay.ts runOne; identical eligible retained input, interests, output language and cutoff per pair. Each system retains its own actual chronological output history with an explicit common cold start. Evaluate all generated output independently and blind. Report all-headlines length as an unmatched-length coverage comparator. Keep current published production output observations separate from offline core V3 replays.
heldOut: Record protocol freeze UTC before acquiring or semantically opening candidate held-out snapshots. Prefer newly published chronological windows after freeze. Group exact source IDs/URLs/text hashes and source-only event identity (actor/action/location/event date, including translations and later updates) together. Exclude groups overlapping development. Select earliest qualifying independent chronological components, not best outcomes. If independence or complete retained evidence cannot be established, report unavailable rather than relabel exposed material held-out.
primaryDetection: Case-category adverse labels: factual contradicted/unsupported claims; citation unsupported/missing; coverage omitted importance>=2 in grounded inventory; relevance irrelevant; repetition repeated; temporal/language incorrect. Unknown/uncertain are abstentions, not proven errors. Include matching structured findings. Separately report the deployed flagged() alert behavior, including limitations and uncertain evidence.
metrics: TP/FP/TN/FN, precision, recall, F1, specificity, false-positive/negative rates, exact case any-fault detection, category/language strata, abstentions and parser/provider failures. Report raw denominators, undefined ratios as null. Do not turn failed reviews into clean outputs; report completed-only scores plus conservative failure-adjusted sensitivity bounds. Preserve all model disagreements and their evidence.
quality: Report supported atomic claims, citation correctness, grounded important-development recall, repetition, temporal correctness, language and relevance separately. Never collapse them into an unsupported global quality percentage. Claim extraction and importance inventories remain judge-dependent. No human accuracy or real-world news completeness claim.
statistics: Pair by window and cluster by event-connected chronological track; variants/translations are not independent samples. Descriptive results for tiny strata; no superiority inference without adequate independent components. No p-value based on individual generated claims or translated variants.
accounting: Separate local evaluator SQLite/R2-compatible artifact store using existing evaluator reserve/judge accounting. Immutable request/response hashes, provider generation IDs, usage, actual cost, stage latency and failure state. No live D1/R2 writes, deployments, notification changes or publishing changes. No automatic transport retries or resending unknown outcomes. Reuse settled operations exactly. New model family is offline only.
stopping: Execute available qualified cases. Provider refusal, missing credentials, unknown outcomes, exhausted provider credit or unavailable independent data must be reported. Do not claim an unperformed experiment from configuration or tests. Any protocol amendment must be versioned before its new inference and separated from the frozen primary analysis.
